messages:
sam: quick heads up — staging started returning intermittent 502s from the embed endpoint after today's quant merge. suspect serializer header shape drift. need a hotfix image and a pinned rollout. proposing `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-hotpatch:2024-07-21-rc1`.

deploybot: Deploy request received (id: dr-7770). Approvals required: oncall + infra. suggested canary: 4m. expedited=true.

morgan: Oncall here, I can watch it. How many requests hit that path in prod normally?

sam: Prod path is ~0.5% of calls but it's in a batching pipeline so retries could amplify. Staging hit ~5% for short sequences. rollback triggers I'd use: embeddings.error_rate increase >= 2% sustained 4m OR p95 latency > 850ms for 5m.

sam: rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to last known-good
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-12
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# emergency undo
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service
```

ira: infra +1 for a 9m midwindow starting 18:30 UTC. need the release doc link and a one-liner for the changelog. also pin configmap hash. @morgan please confirm.

morgan: i will approve once staging canary evidence shows >=12m clean. @sam do we have grafana snapshots attached?

sam: staging canary ran 13m clean after tweak, screenshots uploaded to the release doc: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/embed-hotpatch-2024-07-21 (one-liner: fix serializer header drift after quant merge; pin hotpatch image; include rollback policy). configmap: `cfg-4b2d9a`.

sam: deploybot, run expedited: `expedite --id dr-7770 --force --midwindow 9m --notify #eng-releases`

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled dr-7770 -> prod. Canary 4m, progressive rollout after canary. midwindow reserved 9m starting 1810101025. monitors: embeddings.error_rate, embeddings.p95, kvcache.miss. watchers: morgan, ira, sam. logs tail: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 50`

ops-bot: alert ramp 20s. bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-hotpatch-serializer. pager: if embeddings.error_rate > 2% for 4m -> page ops-lead + post to #incidents.

morgan: oncall ACK. i'll watch p95 and error_rate and run rollback plus page #incidents if we breach.

sam: thanks team — will post a brief blameless follow-up after stabilization. :thumbsup:
